scope: Model/editor quality-v2 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0064; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Quality-v2 remediation rechecked learner-facing English, removed known weak/teacher-directive patterns where present, and kept the bounded target pragmatically licensed by its prompt.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: استفاده کردن preserves the selected service/employ sense of use.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: The object changes while the target verb remains stable across guided and retrieval activities.

distractorQuality.evidence: Placeholder/generic distractors were removed where present; choices use contrastive alternatives with distinct teaching feedback.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: The scene and adjacent turns were checked again so character prompts function as dialogue rather than teacher commands.

difficultyFit.evidence: Sentence structure and object vocabulary are tightly controlled.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: The target is repeated with two familiar objects.

transferQuality.evidence: Final retrieval changes the object, requiring recombination.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, verb sense and activities align.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed; boredom, perceived difficulty and retention remain unverified.
